purpose: Preserve all fixed-roster predictions across interrupted evaluation without mixing models, inputs, configurations or code versions.
storage: One lossless all-class JSON per image, including empty and zero-area outputs. Fixed32-image batches plus remainder. Each batch has an ordered input-content and record SHA256 commit manifest; directory rename publishes only a fully written batch. Completion binds all commit hashes in order.
binding: Archive manifest fixes endpoint/dataset IDs, checkpoint and protocol hashes, source hashes, runtime, original inference settings and ordered image metadata/content SHA256. Changed bindings, missing/extra/reordered records or any changed prediction bytes fail verification.
resume: Exclusive kernel file lock. Verify every committed batch before append/resume and at completion. Skip committed batches; never overwrite them. Preserve interrupted staging directories as evidence and do not count them. Only an uncommitted whole batch may be repeated after technical interruption. Readers may score only a complete verified archive.
actual_tensor_guard: Each committed batch requires one recorded actual model input with shape[B,3,640,640] and dtype torch.float32. The future runner must separate warmup/setup probes from actual inference and obtain these traces from hooks, not from declared settings.
durability_scope: Files are flushed and fsynced before atomic directory rename; containing directories are fsynced on Linux. Windows directory fsync is unavailable here, so no equivalent power-loss guarantee is claimed. Corrupt initialization/completion metadata fail closed and require inspected recovery. Tests simulate orphan staging and tampering; they do not certify every hardware/power-loss failure mode.
validation: All16 named synthetic cases pass on Windows and Linux with identical evidence. Covers interruption staging preservation, append/resume round trip, empty/zero-area/other-class outputs, changed checkpoint/protocol/source/runtime/input/geometry/precision, concurrent locking, missing/extra/tampered records, ordering and completion guards.
remaining: Integration runner must hash actual checkpoint/source/image bytes, provide genuine forward traces, verify runtime and unchanged input/checkpoint state, and skip all committed batches. Synthetic inference interruption/resume integration, final48endpoint manifest, all real fixed-roster evaluations and manuscript/scientific work remain pending.
